description: Fixed-fee quote returned by POST /v1/quote. Accept with POST /v1/request before expires_at.

fee_usd.description: Fixed fee in USD. Sprint/Standard/Rush are one-time per version; Continuous is per month per skill.

method.description: 'webhook' if a callback.webhook_url was provided, otherwise 'poll' the job status URL.

payment_instructions.description: How to pay. Placeholder in the reference implementation; wired to the live payment rail at deploy time.

quote_id.description: Opaque quote identifier. Pass to POST /v1/request to open a job.

recurring.description: false for one-time tiers; 'monthly' for Continuous.

target.description: Echo of the quoted target (package + version + transport).

title: SkillProof quote response
